subject: Shortened plans for Saturday street meeting
text: Hello, I am writing to adjust the arrangements for the small street meeting planned near the entrance on Saturday afternoon. My priorities have changed after reviewing committee notes. The revised aim is a brief conversation about temporary lighting, the walkway surface, and whether residents must clear anything from the shared area. Please plan for thirty minutes rather than a full hour, and focus only on the items above. If the timing conflicts with your schedule, a short note will help us settle it quickly before this Friday.
